data: What is the maximum number of sentences from wikipedia that the EN vector space was trained on?

The caption states that the EN vector space was fully trained on Wikipedia of different sizes, and the x-axis in Figure 4(b) shows English Wikipedia SIZES: # sentences. The x-axis ranges from 100k to 10M15M, which indicates the maximum number of sentences the EN vector space was trained on. Therefore, the maximum number of sentences is 15 million.
